_comment: Package registry for the engineering-loadout installer (formerly dotfiles). See pre_built/ADDING_BINARIES.md for the workflow.

_schema.default: If true, installed when no selection flags given. Inverted polarity of legacy 'optional'. When both present, 'default' wins.
_schema.platforms: List of platforms where this package is valid: 'linux', 'macos', 'windows'. Default ['linux'] when omitted.
_schema.depends: Hard dependencies: package names (or @group refs) that MUST be installed alongside this one. Resolver auto-pulls them; skipping a hard dep of a selected pkg is an error unless --no-deps or --force.
_schema.recommends: Soft dependencies: package names (or @group refs) auto-pulled when available; silently dropped if skipped or unavailable.
_schema.archive: Path (relative to repo root) to the archive this package extracts. For kinds 'runtime', 'font', 'data', 'python-base'.
_schema.install_to: Target install path. '~' expanded at install time.
_schema.source: Source dir or file (relative to repo root). For kind='env'.
_schema.extra_links: List of {from, to} entries describing additional symlinks to create after the env is installed.
_schema.supports_layers: For kind='env': layer names (corp/site/project/user) the env supports for user overrides.
_schema.run_install_scripts: For kind='env': if true, run install hooks discovered in the deployed env dir.
_schema.members: For kind='group': list of package names or @group refs the group expands to. Resolver expands recursively with cycle detection.
_schema.bins: (legacy) List of bin/*.bz2 stems (without .bz2) owned by this package.
_schema.libs: (legacy) List of lib64/*.bz2 stems exclusively owned by this package. Omit or leave empty for libs shared by multiple tools — those are always installed.
_schema.typelibs: (legacy) List of typelibs/*.typelib files required by this package (documentation only; all typelibs in the dir are always installed).
_schema.wheels: (legacy) List of Python package names whose wheels are bundled in wheels/ for offline uv tool install.
_schema.uv_tool: (legacy) Package name passed to 'uv tool install' for Python-based tools. Triggers install_python_tools().
_schema.version: (legacy) Version of the bundled binary or package.
_schema.optional: DEPRECATED — use 'default: false' instead. Still honored when 'default' is absent.
